offerings.title: Mentoring and Coaching the Next Generation
offerings.body: A bit about me: my name is Dr. Adam Weiss and I have been privately practicing Orthodontics for the past 32 years. I am board-certified and currently own/manage 8 Orthodontic/Pediatric Dental practices across the Philadelphia region. I have experience developing all models of private practice and have been employed as a faculty member at Albert Einstein Medical Center’s Department of Orthodontics since 2020.

offerings.title: Don't Go It Alone
offerings.body: Core Areas of Guidance: Practice Model Selection, Case Reviews and Clinical Discussions, Customer Handling, Contract negotiations, Work/Life balance

offerings.title: Start your Mentorship Journey
offerings.body: Case Reviews and Clinical Discussion: The focus of this guidance is not intended to help you with another way to correct something such as a Class II, but instead is intended to offer you a sounding board and second opinion as you work through difficult cases or review clinical Orthodontics.

experience.title: Walk in knowing who they are
experience.body: Name, place, and a clear call path above the fold.

experience.title: See the room
experience.body: Treatment, reception, and careful hands. Not a handshake in an atrium.

experience.title: Book with them
experience.body: Hours and insurance questions stay on their official site.
